'''Tyler Nafzinger''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[October 2001 Normal tournament]] in October 2001, according to Bradley Augsburger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3044">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-10-normal-illinois-the-saga-continuesd3044/ normal-illinois-the-saga-continues], DeckTech (Bradley "BadBrad" Augsburger, 10 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-10-normal-illinois-the-saga-continuesd3044/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
